name: Curse Dispersal (Item Mastery)
body:
You can disperse the adverse flow of magic in a cursed item.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Use Magic Device 5 ranks, Wisdom 15+.

Benefit(s): You can wear or wield some cursed magic items without suffering adverse or negative effects. Such items function like non-magical mundane items for you. Your occultist level must be equal to or more than the caster level of the cursed item in order for this feat to function.
